messages:
Zo (growth): Quick sync: need a fresh benchmark narrative for the launch — short blog, landing, and webinar. priority: show latency <> $ impact in a single glance.
Cass (design): Idea: a small multiplot strip — left: latency CDF, middle: dollars/token heatmap, right: recommended config card. Mobile-first.
Marta (analytics): I can produce the CDFs and heatmap from our top-6 models across 3 seq lengths. will annotate shading for cache hit scenarios.
Jon (product): Core line: 'Pick the responsiveness you need. Pay only for it.' want something punchier for social.
Rae (ops): Ops caveat: we cannot promise hard ms. suggest 'median typicals' + a small explainer about routing fallback and quantization tradeoffs. I'll provide vetted ranges.
Zo (growth): Social headline candidates: A) 'Responsiveness that scales. Costs that shrink.' B) 'Tune latency. Tune spend.' lean A.
Cass (design): For the webinar demo let's do a live slider controlling 'latency weight' and animate the heatmap to show $ impact in real time. Engineer-friendly spec required.
Marta (analytics): Experiment plan: two landing variants. Variant L foregrounds latency plots and demo CTA; Variant C foregrounds cost heatmap and cost estimator CTA. Randomize 50/50 for initial test.
Jon (product): Routing: add a hidden field on signup 'latency_priority' default false. If true or if use-case contains 'real-time' route to dedicated-sales. Otherwise standard nurture. Need copy templates for both flows.
Rae (ops): I'll write the routing rule and the fallback proof blurb. Also attach sim outputs showing tail latency reduction with fallback on and on without it.
Zo (growth): Owners: blog/webinar copy = Zo, design = Cass, data + dashboards = Marta, SDR templates = Jon, ops verification = Rae. Timeline: outline by Tue, assets Wed, final by Fri.
Cass (design): Wireframes Wed AM. Put the interactive spec into a single gif and a 3-frame fallback snapshot for the one-pager.
Marta (analytics): Publishing data to drive and a small reproducible notebook. will include CSVs for 64/512/2k contexts. link soon.
Jon (product): SDR two-liners: latency-first: 'We help teams hit consistent sub-XXms medians at 512 tokens with routing and cache. Want a runbook demo?' cost-first: 'See how batching and quantization cut inference cost by ~Y%.' leave XX/Y blank until ops signs off.
Rae (ops): Will not approve exact XX/Y until sim validation. I'll provide safe bounded ranges e.g., 'typical median reductions' and percentage ranges.
Zo (growth): KPI plan: track signups -> demo requests -> MQLs. Also capture clickthrough on cost-estimator and demo play. Marta will wire UTMs.
SignupsBot: Reminder: landing stub created at 1748254400. RSVPs: 0 -> 1. (auto)
Zo (growth): Final: prioritize latency-first on paid, cost-first in nurture. Capture latency_priority for routing and we'll iterate post-webinar with conversion data. Thanks team!
Jon (product): One more: include a micro-case: 'live chat at 75ms vs 150ms, cost delta per 1M tokens' as a single callout in the blog.
Cass (design): Noted. will craft a compact callout tile.
Marta (analytics): Uploading CSV now: https://drive.mock/redwood/marketing/bench-velocity-heat.csv
Rae (ops): I'll validate numbers before publish. don't publish until ops sign-off on figures.
Zo (growth): Agreed. Meeting adjourned.
